    instead of "settings" were silently ignored. The struct would
    deserialize successfully with all default values, giving no
    indication that the user's intended configuration was discarded.
    
    Add deny_unknown_fields to BivvyConfig, Settings, StepConfig,
    WorkflowConfig, StepOverride, WorkflowSettings, EnvironmentConfig,
    and StepEnvironmentOverride. Missing fields still get their
    defaults, but unrecognized fields now produce a clear parse error
    naming the offending key.

    Reject unknown fields in config instead of silently using defaults
    
    Previously, all config structs used #[serde(default)] without
    #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)], which meant typos like "sttings"
    instead of "settings" were silently ignored. The struct would
    deserialize successfully with all default values, giving no
    indication that the user's intended configuration was discarded.
    
    Add deny_unknown_fields to BivvyConfig, Settings, StepConfig,
    WorkflowConfig, StepOverride, WorkflowSettings, EnvironmentConfig,
    and StepEnvironmentOverride. Missing fields still get their
    defaults, but unrecognized fields now produce a clear parse error
    naming the offending key.
